_comment: Per-role model routes (FORGE-477). Each value is {provider, model}. A role with no route here uses the durable harness selection (PUT /v1/harness/selection). Override per deployment with METAFORGE_MODEL_ROUTES_PATH (a file of the same shape) or METAFORGE_ROUTE_<ROLE>=provider:model (role upper-cased, ':' and '-' as '_', e.g. METAFORGE_ROUTE_PHASE_BRAIN_MECHANICAL). A project can carry its own routes under projects.<project_id>.roles. Every route is checked at load with the provider/model family rule (FORGE-468); a bad route refuses to load.
